create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on a class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor with no type enforcement for flexible attribute access
use_ManagedAttribute_get: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor __get__ method to retrieve a private attribute value from an object
use_ManagedAttribute_set: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor __set__ method to set a value with optional type validation on an object
review_ManagedAttribute: review the ManagedAttribute descriptor class and its type enforcement logic for Runner and Reducer components
